items.title: RoundWhiteDiscKit update for SwiftFormat parse fix
changes: Updated RoundWhiteDiscKit submodule to pick up a SwiftFormat parse fix.
Local builds that were failing during formatting should now succeed.

Bump RoundWhiteDiscKit for the SwiftFormat parse fix

includedPullRequests.title: Bump RoundWhiteDiscKit for the SwiftFormat parse fix
includedPullRequests.body:
| Submodule | Branch | Old → New |
| --- | --- | --- |
| RoundWhiteDiscKit | `main` | `e66da6c` → `7dd6396` |

Picks up the SwiftFormat parse fix (airedev326/RoundWhiteDiscKit#1). The `loopandlearn` fork was fast-forwarded to upstream first; the two commits are that fix and its merge.

This unblocks local builds. SwiftFormat 0.47 could not parse the attributed conformance in `SensorScannerNG.Event`'s inheritance clause, so the format phase aborted and then reformatted submodule sources it had been told to exclude — producing compile errors in `LoopKit` that looked unrelated. `CI=true` was the workaround.

Linted with the version the project uses (0.47.11): 1 parse error at the old pin, 0 at the new one.

Everything else is already at the tip of its tracked branch. Checked both directions — each `loopandlearn` fork against its upstream parent as well — and RoundWhiteDiscKit was the only one behind.

includedPullRequests.title: Rebuild glucose target profiles when the chart window passes their end
includedPullRequests.body: closes #1581 only the home chart target line is changed (`updateStartEndMarkers` in StartEndMarkerSetup.swift). as @StephaneMARTINEZ13600 showed, the green target line stops at 00:00 while glucose keeps going. cause: `setupGlucoseTargets` builds `targetProfiles` only at launch and on a settings or targets change. `processFetchedTargets` makes one profile per day up to a midnight after the `endMarker` of that moment (#1383 widened the span, but still only at build time). the chart's `endMarker` moves with every reading and on foreground, so after about one to two days without a restart or a settings change it passes the last profile, and the line ends at that midnight. a restart brings it back. change: when `updateStartEndMarkers` moves `endMarker` past the last profile's end, rebuild the profiles from the cached `bgTargets` and the new `startMarker`. this runs about once a day, on the main actor like the other callers. temp targets and overrides use their own data and are not affected. tested in the simulator with a local-only change that cuts the profiles at today's 00:00 (the state the app reaches after a day), then background and foreground: - before: the target line stops at 00:00 - after: the target line continues past 00:00 to the right edge of the chart | before | after | | --- | --- | | | |

includedPullRequests.title: Upload pump-programmed bolus flag to Nightscout
includedPullRequests.body:
Boluses programmed on the pump itself are stored as BolusStored.isProgrammedByPumpUI as of #1580 but were not included in the Nightscout treatment payload. Send it as isProgrammedByPumpUI on bolus treatments (omitted when false), re-upload an uploaded row when the flag changes on finalization, and include it in the upload-stamp check.

@dnzxy
